title: Analytical Procedures (Identity of colorants) [Identification] [Basic Coating Premix Red]
description: Core quality information (2.3.3.AP) for Analytical Procedures (Identity of colorants) [Identification] [Basic Coating Premix Red].

action.title: Principle
action.description: The visual comparison of the colour of a film made from both the test substance and in-house reference substance.

action.title: Equipment
action.description: 1.     Device for film production 2.     White cardboard 3.     Propeller-type stirrer or blender

action.title: Procedure
action.description: Dispersion: Disperse 20 mg of test substance in 60 ml of de-ionized water. 15 mL of the dispersion are needed to prepare a film on a UGC-2 card.  Prepare a dispersion also for the in-house reference substance in the same manner.

action.title: Evaluation
action.description: Compare the colour of the film against a film of the in-house reference substance. The test substance is deemed acceptable if the colour of the film matches that of the authentic reference substance.

action.title: Alternative
action.description: The dispersion may also be prepared using an “Eppendorf” reaction vessel and a Vortex with 10 mg of test substance.
